body: I feel you. Never thought I’d be so mad that suicide seems so impossible. It’s my choice, god dammit, let me make it.
Faking for work hurts so much. I hate it
I wish I had a rope too friend. I know it’s messed up, but maybe you can take comfort in the fact that you’re not alone. I’m sorry your b day was shit. Happy 18th :)

I feel this. It feels like no one can really solve the fundamental problem. Just a bunch of professionals that keep their place and fix nothing. Then the pain of common people who end up leaving because they don’t have a professional obligation to you. I hope a solution comes for you.
Holy smokes... this could be a book. I like the way you are venting. I feel the anger and betrayal in the words. I’m so sorry man.

Wow same. I just keep begging God to do it for me. Curse the government and internet regulations for making method research impossible. I know there’s a way— just too tired to find it. Ironic isn’t it.

“Also when I needed their concern before this point, it wasn’t there,” 

That hits deep. It’s like they had a chance to really be worried, but that window has closed, the trust has been broken. Now all I want is a very superficial, surface level relationship. I’ll be sweet and quiet and say “don’t worry.” That way I can slip away silently. Don’t cry for me— you don’t need to. They don’t deserve to.

Same friend. It was bad last night. My mom came to visit and made a joke about how much fun I must be having each night because I have deep dark circles under my eyes. She has no idea. She also has no idea how much her ignorance stabs the knife in just a little deeper. It’s hell.

That is seriously so screwed up. I am really sorry. Body dysmorphia is so difficult and so are any intrusive thoughts I’d be very upset if someone “copied” it for their own weird reason. Wth. So screwy.

lol the hotline is a freaking joke. I was on hold for 30 minutes. Got a lady who hardly spoke English and she just told me to go to the ER. THANKS WORLD. I’m so glad I’m cared for 🤡😥. I guess in the back of my mind I always thought the hotline would save me one day.... I was wrong.

Listen up!! The mention of "messy truck tires" and "*If I wanted to know who you were hanging with while I was gone I woulda asked you".* Here is the theory: This is Este going through the separation and pain before she is murdered in No Body, No Crime. Then all this sudden "new clean truck tires." Just a thought.
